business_problem: Inter needed to evolve a large, API-heavy conversational banking environment into a more scalable AI operating model without breaking the integrations, governance controls, and continuity behind critical customer self-service journeys.
solution_summary: Inter established an orchestration foundation for its banking AI operations by deploying IBM watsonx Orchestrate on IBM Cloud and migrating its existing assistant estate onto that layer. The bank's Seven assistant already supported more than 180 products, around 80 transactional journeys, and more than 100 APIs, so the new architecture had to preserve continuity while enabling more contextual experiences. IBM and Inter transitioned all 18 assistants while keeping integrations and access controls intact, then used watsonx Orchestrate APIs to automate operational tasks such as deployments and governance workflows. The platform now coordinates multiple AI agents across self-service journeys including address updates, credit-limit inquiries, card replacements, and payroll-loan tracking. Inter also set up a Center of Excellence to standardize development and governance, turning its large conversational environment into a reusable operating model for future agentic banking initiatives.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Coordinates AI agents and automates deployment and governance activities across Inter's banking journeys.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the orchestration foundation used to run Inter's conversational and agentic banking services.

data_flow: Customer requests flow through Inter's AI environment, where watsonx Orchestrate coordinates the agents and service integrations behind banking self-service journeys on IBM Cloud, while deployment APIs automate the release and governance processes needed to keep those journeys up to date.
business_outcome: Inter reduced deployment effort dramatically, preserved continuity across customer-facing banking journeys, and created a scalable governance-led foundation for expanding agentic AI across a 45 million-customer financial platform.
